'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Jack Koswicki DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jack Koswicki]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
